how.title: How it works
how.intro: Three simple steps. No app, no paper cards.

steps.title: Buy your coffee
steps.body: Order whatever you love: espresso, freddo, cappuccino.

steps.title: Get stamped
steps.body: Your barista taps your phone and the stamp lands instantly.

steps.title: Enjoy your free one
steps.body: At 10 stamps you get a coupon for a coffee on the house.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: What data we keep for the stamp card, why, and how you control it.

who.title: Who we are
who.body: {name}, {address}, is responsible for your data. For anything about your data, email us at {email}.

what.title: What we keep
items: Your email, so you can sign in.
Your name, only if you add it.
Your stamps: when you got them and from which tag.
Your coupons: the code, when each was issued, when it expires and when it was redeemed.
what.none: We don't keep your phone number, address or payment details, and we don't send marketing emails.

why.title: Why
why.body: To run the stamp card you signed up for (performing a contract, GDPR Article 6(1)(b)) and to prevent misuse such as double stamps or copied coupons (legitimate interest, GDPR Article 6(1)(f)).

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: We only use the cookies the site needs to work. We don't use analytics or advertising cookies, so we don't ask for consent.
items: cp_login_email: your email for 15 minutes, for the "Check your email" screen.
cp_pending_tap: a stamp waiting for you to sign in, for up to 15 minutes.

who_sees.title: Who sees your data
who_sees.body: The cafe owner sees your email, stamps and coupons. Staff only see the coupon they scan. The data is stored for us by Supabase (database and sign-in), the service that sends sign-in emails, and the company that hosts the site. We don't sell your data or give it to anyone else.

how_long.title: How long
how_long.body: For as long as you have an account. When you delete it, we immediately erase your email, name, stamps and coupons. Hosting providers may keep technical logs (such as IP addresses) for a few days for security.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can see and download your data, correct your name and delete your account, all from "My account". For anything else, email us. If you think we haven't handled your data properly, you can contact the Commissioner for Personal Data Protection of Cyprus.
